title: Bolt.new Review 2026: Features, Pricing, Limits & Alternatives

facts.fact: Bolt.new's Free plan costs $0 and includes 1M tokens per month with a 300K tokens-per-day limit, according to the vendor pricing table as listed at the time of writing.
facts.value: $0; 1M tokens per month; 300K tokens per day
facts.unit: USD; tokens per month; tokens per day
facts.quote: | Free | $0 | 1M per month, 300K per day | Bolt branding, 10 MB uploads, limited hosting |

facts.fact: Bolt.new's Pro plan starts at $25 per month and includes 10M tokens per month with no daily cap, according to the pricing table listed at the time of writing.
facts.unit: USD per month; tokens per month
facts.quote: | Pro | From $25 per month | From 10M per month, no daily cap | Custom domains, no Bolt branding, larger uploads, token rollover |

facts.fact: Bolt.new's Teams plan costs $30 per member per month, and tokens are allocated per member rather than pooled.
facts.quote: | Teams | $30 per member per month | Per member, not pooled | Centralized billing and admin controls |

facts.fact: Bolt.new's Enterprise plan is priced on a custom basis, with custom token allowances and a contact-sales process.
Bolt.new's Free plan limits uploads to 10 MB.
facts.quote: Bolt branding, 10 MB uploads, limited hosting

facts.fact: Bolt.new does not publish how many tokens a typical prompt uses, so costs are hard to forecast for large apps or long sessions.
facts.quote: Because Bolt does not publish how many tokens a typical prompt uses, costs are hard to forecast for large apps or long sessions.

facts.fact: Bolt.new charges by tokens consumed as the AI reads and writes code, not by seats or prompts.
facts.quote: Bolt.new charges by tokens, which are consumed as the AI reads and writes code, not by seats or prompts.

facts.fact: Bolt.new is a chat-driven, browser-native development tool from StackBlitz powered by WebContainers that generates full-stack web apps from natural-language prompts.
facts.quote: Bolt.new AI (also known as Bolt AI) is a chat-driven, browser-native development tool powered by StackBlitz’s WebContainers.

facts.fact: Bolt.new can target iOS and Android mobile apps through Expo (React Native) from one codebase, with previews in Expo Go.
facts.quote: Bolt uses Expo (React Native) to target iOS and Android from one codebase. You preview with Expo Go

facts.fact: The article says a first working Bolt.new prototype typically takes minutes to produce, though refining it takes longer.
facts.quote: a first working prototype typically takes minutes, though refining it takes longer.

facts.fact: Higher Pro tiers with larger token allowances exist beyond the listed Pro plan.
facts.quote: Higher Pro tiers with larger token allowances also exist.
